mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of instances where UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in two months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST decreases > 5% in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in two months signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases > 1% in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a restrictive monetary policy combined with economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5% and GDPC1 growth < 0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over three months signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200,000 over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by less than 1% YoY and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 5%, it signals weak consumer demand combined with high unemployment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: weak consumer demand with high unemployment
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS YoY growth < 1% and UNRATE > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 70% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.5% in 1 month.
